data.display_address: La Vie, Jumeirah Beach Residence, Dubai
data.long_description:
Provident Real Estate is thrilled to present this stunning 3-bedroom apartment for rent at La Vie, Jumeirah Beach Residence (JBR), offering a blend of luxurious living and breathtaking views.

Property Details:

3 Spacious Bedrooms
Maid’s Room for added convenience
5 Modern Bathrooms
2 Dedicated Parking Spaces
Size: 2,062.04 sq.ft.
Fully Furnished with stylish interiors
Panoramic Views of Dubai Eye and the Sea

  La Vie is situated in the heart of JBR, a dynamic beachfront community with an array of shopping outlets, international dining options, boutique cafés, and open-air lounges. The area hosts lively street markets and family-friendly events, making it an ideal location for those who enjoy a vibrant, yet relaxing lifestyle by the beach.

Amenities Include:

Barbecue Area for social gatherings
Changing Rooms and Children’s Play Areas
Children’s Swimming Pool for family fun
Communal Gardens and Relaxing Green Spaces
Fully Equipped Gymnasium and High-Speed Elevators
Jogging Track, Multi-Purpose Room
Steam and Sauna Rooms, Winding Walkways

  This apartment offers a luxurious lifestyle with all the amenities and convenience of JBR at your doorstep.
